card.name: Religion and culture history prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (been, like, and, by, the, a) and single letters starting names, in web passages about religion, pagan or ancient cultures, and cultural history. It fires just before a religion, culture or scholar name is expected.

modes.label: Linking word in religion talk
modes.description: A small word such as been, like, by, the or a in text about faiths, pagans or myths.

modes.description: A lone capital letter that begins a scholar's or group's name in cultural or racial-history text.
modes.example: between “Aryan” on the one hand and “<<C>>aucasian,” “European,” “
